summary: On node1, built an LVM-backed XFS filesystem for /srv/data (loop-backed VG since the root disk had no free partition/LVM/btrfs support), populated baseline application data, took an LVM snapshot, modified the data (edited config, appended to data.db, deleted a log file, added a junk file), then restored the exact snapshot content via lvconvert --merge and verified SHA256 checksums matched the baseline exactly. Made the setup persistent via a systemd oneshot unit (srv-data-loop.service) + fstab entry. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the loop device, LVM VG, /srv/data mount, and data checksums all recovered automatically post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 filesystem/OS (CentOS Stream 10, single XFS root partition, no btrfs support)
Verified LVM2 tooling available and 19G free on root
Created PV/VG(vg_data)/LV(data_lv, 3G) leaving 3G free for snapshot COW, formatted XFS
Created systemd unit srv-data-loop.service to losetup+vgchange -ay before local-fs.target, enabled it, added /etc/fstab entry with x-systemd.requires
Populated baseline app data (config, data.db, log) and recorded SHA256 checksums
Created LVM snapshot data_snap1 of data_lv
Modified /srv/data (changed config, appended data.db, deleted log, added junk file)
Unmounted /srv/data and merged snapshot into origin via lvconvert --merge
Remounted /srv/data and verified checksums matched exact baseline snapshot content
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, polled until exec available again
Verified changed boot_id, confirmed loop device/VG/LV/mount auto-recovered via systemd unit, and re-verified data checksums post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Baseline data captured and healthy before disruption
evidence.summary: Created app files under /srv/data with recorded SHA256 checksums; created LVM snapshot data_snap1 of data_lv capturing this state
Changed settings.conf content, appended to data.db, deleted app.log, added app/tmp/junk.txt - file listing shows divergence from baseline
lvconvert --merge completed 100%; remounted volume and sha256sum -c against baseline manifest reports OK for all three original files, junk file and appended data gone

evidence.requirement: node1 pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9, uptime, mount state, and re-verified checksums OK before reboot
systemctl reboot issued in background; connection dropped confirming the command was accepted and the node began shutting down

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: Post-reboot boot_id 56057518-e382-4fcf-b68a-dea577252a4b differs from baseline, fresh uptime timestamp confirms new boot; srv-data-loop.service active, loop0/VG/LV/mount auto-recreated, and sha256sum -c confirms /srv/data content intact after restart
